definition.boundary: Analytically zero stationary no-slip velocity on every boundary. Existing native L2 projection has up to 2.38e-15 m/s roundoff, not exactly zero stored coefficients.
definition.operator: Same native condensed P1 cell/face Stokes, P1 pressure, P2 velocity reconstruction. Existing RT1 lift and full symmetric or Laplacian viscosity reused without changed K or b.
definition.traction: For a boundary face, residual moments r_j=(K_local state-rhs_local)_face,j including stabilization and RT1 face body-load. t_h(s)=(r_0+12*s*r_1)/face_length, s in [-1/2,1/2].
definition.stationaryWallPressure: p_t=-n dot t_h. For smooth incompressible no-slip stationary walls, exact n dot grad(u) dot n=0. This is a physical wall-closure reconstruction, not a claim that discrete weak normal strain is zero.
definition.stressPressureControl: p_sigma=p_t+c*n dot G_h(u) dot n, c=2 for symmetric and 1 for Laplacian at nu=1. Retained as a distinct negative/nonuniversal control, not selected per case.
definition.omittedFaceLoadControl: Replace residual by K_local state on boundary rows; equivalent to omitting RT1 face load, not a separate flow solve.
definition.pressureGauge: One global volume-weighted mean of p_h-p_exact removed before every trace comparison; never per-face or per-cell centering.
definition.wallNorm: Integral of error squared on all physical boundary faces divided by total boundary length, then square root; units m^2/s^2. Sample maxima are Gauss-point maxima, not certified continuous maxima.
definition.nonzeroFlow: psi=64*g(x-shear*y)*g(y), g(t)=t^2*(1-t)^2; u=(psi_y,-psi_x); p=sin(pi*(x-shear*y))*sin(pi*y)+lambda*(x^3+x*y^2). Exact field/forcing reused from native P1 driver.
definition.hydrostatic: u=0, p=x+2*y+x^3+x*y^2, f=grad(p). This exact problem is valid on every retained polygon.
definition.ring: Native body-fitted polygon rings, radii 0.5 and 1 m; radial/angular pairs (1,8),(2,16),(4,32), with 8/32/128 cells. Not Cartesian cut-cell annuli or the old 6606-cell flow problem. Whole topology passes makeFvMesh2D; no deleted cells or relaxed gates.
definition.reference: Analytic native manufactured fields and their exact-to-quadrature P1 face projections. NumPy only solves native matrix entries and compares exported fields.
definition.cost: 40 full assembly/dense-LA/recovery/wall processes plus 40 additional wall recoveries on unchanged solutions. Bounded maximum 2175 unknowns. Timings exclude compiler and archive; no performance claim.

conclusions: Lifted hydrostatic ring/cut conservative pressure moments agree with analytic P1 face moments to at most 1.30e-14 m^2/s^2 RMS. Remaining pointwise pressure error is the P1 face approximation, not zero.
Lifted symmetric stationary-flow wall pressure decreases but remains 0.14389/0.17511 m^2/s^2 at 16x16 square/sheared grids. Last-step orders about 0.875/1.352; no mature wall-accuracy claim.
Complete symmetric viscosity is not uniformly more accurate than Laplacian at the same coarse controls; all four viscosity/load combinations and unfavorable cases are retained.
Adding reconstructed weak normal viscous stress to the pressure worsens these nonzero-flow controls. It is not a wall-accuracy repair.

The RT1 face body-force contribution is essential for pressure-gradient shifts. Strong gradient control has small pressure-moment shift error but a large finite P1 pressure approximation error; pressure robustness is not pressure accuracy.
No new threshold, product solver/default, original Re20 branch, convection, open-outlet or general curved-wall flow qualification was changed.
